title: Rotate the retention ledger: keep the newest 100 entries and move older summarized ones into the vault with their archive (KNOW-23)
description: Rotate the retention ledger: keep the newest 100 entries and move older summarized ones into the vault with their archive (KNOW-23)
no_spec_change_rationale: KNOW-23 (Leif: Keep newest N, not 14 days, the rest as proposed, 2026-11-05 18:24 MST): a new requirement for ledger rotation at done and for every ledger reader to read the vault shards.
acceptance_criteria: At done the retention ledger keeps its newest 100 entries plus entries without an archive or note; older entries move with their restores into knowledge/attachments/<first archive folder>/pruned.jsonl, shards first, nothing lost or duplicated, reported as applied.ledger_rotation; every ledger reader reads shards then the hot ledger ignoring duplicate lines, so labels, bug views and notes are unchanged; shards union-merge and are not listed as attachments. The new tests fail first and fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: KNOW-23; Leif: Keep newest N, not 14 days, the rest as proposed (2026-11-05 18:24 MST, via the orc); N approved in this scope; 16 MiB ledger bound kept; REQ-cli-041/043/046 unchanged.
